work.name: Tegelweg
work.subtitle: Rental Maisonette
work.description: This apartment grew in phases over five years, from two bedrooms to four. Guests lived with every decision, so layout, material, and styling were kept when they worked and corrected when they did not. Designed for Jubili, the hospitality design brand co-founded as this practice took shape.

work.name: Brabbeegasse
work.subtitle: Single-Unit Apartment
work.description: A rented apartment, redesigned for Jubili as the brand took on more properties. The rooms had to carry a distinct aesthetic for guests and still be handed back as found when the lease ends, so every intervention was designed to be undone.

work.name: Analytical Fingerprint Laboratory Building
work.subtitle: Rehabilitation for Analytical Fingerprint Laboratory Building

roles.name: Petrina Salema
roles.role: Project Manager and Architectural Design Lead, APC Architectural Pioneering Consultants

work.description: A laboratory rehabilitation for a government client, carried from feasibility through construction and the defects period. The feature wall began in the client's own ceramic workshop, where I worked with local craftsmen on custom 3D tiles. I led the architectural design, mentored the junior architects, and stayed on through equipment delays and post-handover faults until the building worked.

work.name: CCBRT Maternity Hospital
work.subtitle: Detail Design and Construction

roles.name: Petrina Salema
roles.role: Project Manager and Architectural Design Lead, APC Architectural Pioneering Consultants

work.description: A maternity hospital leaves no margin for a wall in the wrong place. I led a team of architects through detail design and production information, overlaying every drawing to check the placement of medical equipment against the mechanical, electrical, and plumbing services behind it.

work.name: International School of Tanganyika
work.subtitle: New Athletic Centre

roles.name: Petrina Salema
roles.role: Project Manager and Architectural Design Lead, APC Architectural Pioneering Consultants

work.description: A new athletic centre for the International School of Tanganyika. The site demanded a full topographical resurvey and a revised building permit before the design could stand. I led the design team through both, ran the tender to select the contractor, and presented the project to the school's board at every key stage.

work.name: Montessori Children's House and Primary School
work.subtitle: Competition Entry · 2nd Prize

roles.name: Petrina Salema
roles.role: Project Manager and Architectural Design Lead, APC Architectural Pioneering Consultants

work.description: A competition entry grounded in how Montessori classrooms actually work. The concept grew out of visits to two sites and conversations with the people who would teach and learn there. I led the design team and delivered the pitch, and the proposal took second prize.

work.name: International School of Tanganyika
work.subtitle: Classroom Blocks D & E

roles.name: Petrina Salema
roles.role: Project Manager and Architectural Design Lead, APC Architectural Pioneering Consultants

work.description: Two classroom blocks, followed from drawings into the rooms children use every day. I led the refinement of the fixed-furniture detailing through construction, working closely with junior architects on site, and stayed with the buildings through the defects period and an added scope of detailing.

work.name: Bank of Tanzania
work.subtitle: New Mwanza Branch

roles.name: Petrina Salema
roles.role: Assistant Architect and Interior Designer, Epitome Architects Limited

work.description: A regional headquarters for the Bank of Tanzania, from feasibility through tender award. Before programming a single office I visited the bank's branches in Dar es Salaam, Zanzibar, and Dodoma to see how each department worked. I coordinated a technically demanding building with the MEP engineers and specialist consultants, contributed to the cost exercise that kept the project within budget, and supervised the first phase of construction on site.
